(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  ;; CONSTRAINT: count the number of stacks (bases on the table).
  ;; A stack count state is represented by (count <count-object>).
  ;; limit-ok is true for count0..count3.
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    (started)
    (count ?x)
    (decrement ?x ?y)
    (increment ?x ?y)
    (limit-ok ?x)
  )
  ;; BEGIN ADD constraint: pickup must leave at most 3 stacks
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b ?c ?d)
    :precondition
      (and
        (on-table ?b)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (count ?c)
        (decrement ?c ?d)
        (or (not started) (limit-ok ?c))
        (limit-ok ?d)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (not (on-table ?b))
        (not (clear ?b))
        (not (arm-empty))
        (not (count ?c))
        (count ?d)
        (started)
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
  ;; BEGIN ADD constraint: putdown must leave at most 3 stacks
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b ?c ?d)
    :precondition
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (count ?c)
        (increment ?c ?d)
        (or (not started) (limit-ok ?c))
        (limit-ok ?d)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (on-table ?b)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (not (holding ?b))
        (not (count ?c))
        (count ?d)
        (started)
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
  ;; BEGIN ADD constraint: stack must not increase stack count and must keep <=3
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?k)
    :precondition
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (clear ?c)
        (count ?k)
        (limit-ok ?k)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (on ?b ?c)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (not (holding ?b))
        (not (clear ?c))
        (started)
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
  ;; BEGIN ADD constraint: unstack must keep <=3 stacks
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?k)
    :precondition
      (and
        (on ?b ?c)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (count ?k)
        (limit-ok ?k)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (clear ?c)
        (not (on ?b ?c))
        (not (clear ?b))
        (not (arm-empty))
        (started)
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  ;; CONSTRAINT: number of stacks is represented by a count object.
  ;; limit-ok is true for count0..count3.
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    (count ?x)
    (decrement ?x ?y)
    (increment ?x ?y)
    (limit-ok ?x)
  )
  ;; BEGIN ADD: pickup must leave at most 3 stacks
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b ?c ?d)
    :precondition
      (and
        (on-table ?b)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (count ?c)
        (decrement ?c ?d)
        (limit-ok ?d)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (not (on-table ?b))
        (not (clear ?b))
        (not (arm-empty))
        (not (count ?c))
        (count ?d)
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
  ;; BEGIN ADD: putdown must leave at most 3 stacks
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b ?c ?d)
    :precondition
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (count ?c)
        (increment ?c ?d)
        (limit-ok ?d)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (on-table ?b)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (not (holding ?b))
        (not (count ?c))
        (count ?d)
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
  ;; BEGIN ADD: stack must not exceed 3 stacks
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?k)
    :precondition
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (clear ?c)
        (count ?k)
        (limit-ok ?k)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (on ?b ?c)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (not (holding ?b))
        (not (clear ?c))
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
  ;; BEGIN ADD: unstack must not exceed 3 stacks
  (:action unstack

    :precondition
      (and
        (on ?b ?c)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)

        (holding ?b)
        (clear ?c)
        (not (on ?b ?c))

  ;; END ADD

        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (count ?c)
        (decrement ?c ?d)
        (limit-ok ?d)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (not (on-table ?b))
        (not (clear ?b))
        (not (arm-empty))
        (not (count ?c))
        (count ?d)
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
  ;; BEGIN ADD: putdown must leave at most 3 stacks
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b ?c ?d)
    :precondition
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (count ?c)
        (increment ?c ?d)
        (limit-ok ?d)

    :effect
      (and
        (on-table ?b)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (not (holding ?b))
        (not (count ?c))
        (count ?d)

        (clear ?c)
        (count ?k)

      (and
        (on ?b ?c)
        (clear ?b)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    (is-block1 ?b)
    (is-block6 ?b)
    (must-move6) ; CONSTRAINT: outstanding obligation to move block6 after a move of block1
  )
  ;; Basic action for blocks other than block1 and block6
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                       (not (is-block1 ?b))
                       (not (is-block6 ?b)))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (not (on-table ?b))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))))
  ;; CONSTRAINT: moving block1 creates an obligation to move block6 later
  (:action pickup-block1
    :parameters ()
    :precondition (and (on-table block1) (clear block1) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding block1)
                 (not (on-table block1))
                 (not (clear block1))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (must-move6)))
  ;; CONSTRAINT: moving block6 discharges the obligation
  (:action pickup-block6
    :parameters ()
    :precondition (and (on-table block6) (clear block6) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding block6)
                 (not (on-table block6))
                 (not (clear block6))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (must-move6))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c)
                 (clear ?b)
                 (arm-empty)
                 (not (holding ?b))
                 (not (clear ?c))))
  ;; Basic unstack for blocks other than block1 and block6
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
                       (not (is-block1 ?b))
                       (not (is-block6 ?b)))
    :effect (and (holding ?b)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on ?b ?c))
                 (not (clear ?b))
                 (not (arm-empty))))
  ;; CONSTRAINT: unstacking/moving block1 creates obligation
  (:action unstack-block1
    :parameters (?c)
    :precondition (and (on block1 ?c) (clear block1) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding block1)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on block1 ?c))
                 (not (clear block1))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (must-move6)))
  ;; CONSTRAINT: unstacking/moving block6 discharges obligation
  (:action unstack-block6
    :parameters (?c)
    :precondition (and (on block6 ?c) (clear block6) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding block6)
                 (clear ?c)
                 (not (on block6 ?c))
                 (not (clear block6))
                 (not (arm-empty))
                 (not (must-move6)))))
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  ;; Standard blocksworld domain with a STRIPS-maintained stack counter.
  ;; CONSTRAINT: once a move has been made, the number of stacks (blocks on the table) must be exactly 4.
  ;; (count ?c) records the current number of stacks; (is-four ?c) is true only for c4.
  ;; Each action carries the old and new stack count and requires the resulting count to be four.
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types block count)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y - block)
    (on-table ?x - block)
    (clear ?x - block)
    (holding ?x - block)
    (arm-empty)
    (started)
    (count ?c - count)
    (is-four ?c - count)
    (pick-next ?old ?new - count)
    (put-next ?old ?new - count)
    (stack-next ?old ?new - count)
    (unstack-next ?old ?new - count)
  )
  ;; BEGIN ADD CONSTRAINT MODIFICATIONS
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b - block ?old ?new - count)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (count ?old) (pick-next ?old ?new) (is-four ?new))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (started) (count ?new) (not (count ?old))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b - block ?old ?new - count)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (count ?old) (put-next ?old ?new) (is-four ?new))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (started) (not (holding ?b)) (count ?new) (not (count ?old))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c - block ?old ?new - count)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (count ?old) (stack-next ?old ?new) (is-four ?new))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (started) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)) (count ?new)))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c - block ?old ?new - count)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (count ?old) (unstack-next ?old ?new) (is-four ?new))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (started) (count ?new)))
  ;; END ADD CONSTRAINT MODIFICATIONS
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  ;; Blocksworld domain with an additional constraint:
  ;; no newly formed stack may exceed 5 blocks high.
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types block level - object)
  ;; CONSTRAINT: finite height levels for stack-height tracking
  (:constants level0 level1 level2 level3 level4 level5 level6 level7 - level)
  (:predicates
    (on ?b1 ?b2 - block)
    (on-table ?b - block)
    (clear ?b - block)
    (holding ?b - block)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: height of the current top of a stack (level0 means held)
    (height ?b - block ?l - level)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: successor/predecessor height mappings
    (next ?h1 - level ?h2 - level)
    (prev ?h1 - level ?h2 - level)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: heights onto which another block may be stacked (1..4)
    (can-stack ?h - level)
  )
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b - block)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
      ;; CONSTRAINT: a table block is a stack of height 1
      (height ?b level1))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))
      (not (height ?b level1)) (height ?b level0)))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b - block)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (height ?b level0))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))
      (not (height ?b level0)) (height ?b level1)))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c - block ?h ?h2 - level)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (height ?b level0) (clear ?c)
      (height ?c ?h)
      ;; CONSTRAINT: only allow stacking if resulting height <= 5
      (can-stack ?h)
      (next ?h ?h2))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))
      (not (height ?b level0)) (not (height ?c ?h))
      (height ?b ?h2)))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c - block ?h ?h2 - level)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty)
      (height ?b ?h)
      ;; CONSTRAINT: decrease the source stack height when removing a top block
      (prev ?h ?h2))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))
      (not (height ?b ?h)) (height ?b level0) (height ?c ?h2)))
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  ; CONSTRAINT: Standard Blocksworld constraints are encoded in the action preconditions/effects:
  ; - only one block can be moved at a time via (arm-empty) and (holding ?b)
  ; - only the topmost/clear block can be moved via (clear ?b)
  ; - a block can be placed only on the table or on a clear block via putdown/stack
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )
  ;; BEGIN ADD: standard Blocksworld constraint encoding
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)))
  )
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c)))
  )
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))
  )
  ;; END ADD
)

    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))))

  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types block - object)
  (:predicates
    (on ?top - block ?bottom - block)
    (on-table ?b - block)
    (clear ?b - block)
    (holding ?b - block)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; BEGIN ADD: constraint predicate for even-on-odd stacking
    (forbidden-stack ?top - block ?bottom - block)
    ;; END ADD
  )
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b - block)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b - block)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?top - block ?bottom - block)
    :precondition (and (holding ?top) (clear ?bottom)
      ;; BEGIN ADD: even numbered blocks cannot be stacked on odd numbered blocks
      (not (forbidden-stack ?top ?bottom))
      ;; END ADD
    )
    :effect (and (on ?top ?bottom) (clear ?top) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?top)) (not (clear ?bottom))))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?top - block ?bottom - block)
    :precondition (and (on ?top ?bottom) (clear ?top) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?top) (clear ?bottom) (not (on ?top ?bottom)) (not (clear ?top)) (not (arm-empty)))
  ))

(define (problem blocksworld-p66)
  (:domain blocksworld)
  (:objects block1 block2 block3 block4 block5 block6 - block)
  (:init
    (on-table block3)
    (on block6 block3)
    (on block5 block6)
    (on block4 block5)
    (on block1 block4)
    (on block2 block1)
    (clear block2)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; BEGIN ADD: static forbidden even-on-odd stack pairs
    (forbidden-stack block2 block1)
    (forbidden-stack block2 block3)
    (forbidden-stack block2 block5)
    (forbidden-stack block4 block1)
    (forbidden-stack block4 block3)
    (forbidden-stack block4 block5)
    (forbidden-stack block6 block1)
    (forbidden-stack block6 block3)
    (forbidden-stack block6 block5)
    ;; END ADD
  )
  (:goal (and
    (on-table block1)
    (on-table block2)
    (on block6 block2)
    (on-table block4)
    (on block3 block4)
    (on-table block5)
  ))
)

  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
  )
  ;; BEGIN ADD: constraint-related action definitions
  ;; CONSTRAINT: a block can be picked up only if it is on the table, clear, and arm empty
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  ;; CONSTRAINT: a held block can be put down on the table
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))
  ;; CONSTRAINT: a held block can be stacked only on a clear block
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))))
  ;; CONSTRAINT: a block can be unstacked only if it is clear and arm empty
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  ;; END ADD
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?b ?c)
    (on-table ?b)
    (clear ?b)
    (holding ?b)
    (arm-empty))

  ;; CONSTRAINT: only one block can be moved at a time; arm-empty is true only when no block is held
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  ;; CONSTRAINT: a block can only be picked up if no block is on top of it
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))
  ;; CONSTRAINT: a block can only be placed on another block if that block is clear
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))))
  ;; CONSTRAINT: a block can only be unstacked if it is the top clear block
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  ;; END ADD
)

(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  ;; CONSTRAINT: every second block move (2nd, 4th, 6th, ...) must be a block whose number is a multiple of 4.
  ;; A move is a complete relocation of a block. We count the move at the take action (pickup or unstack) because that is when the block is selected; the later putdown or stack completes the same move.
  ;; move-odd means the next take is an odd-numbered move; move-even means the next take is even and must be multiple4.
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; BEGIN ADD: constraint-specific predicates
    (multiple4 ?x)
    (move-odd)
    (move-even)
    ;; END ADD
  )
  ;; BEGIN ADD: constraint-specific modifications.
  ;; The four basic operations are pickup, putdown, stack, and unstack.
  ;; pickup and unstack are split into odd/even take variants; putdown and stack complete a move and do not change the move counter.
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (move-odd) (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (move-even) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (not (move-odd))))
  (:action pickup-even
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (move-even) (multiple4 ?b) (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (move-odd) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (not (move-even))))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (move-odd) (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (move-even) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (not (move-odd))))
  (:action unstack-even
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (move-even) (multiple4 ?b) (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (move-odd) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)) (not (move-even))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))))

  ;; CONSTRAINT: standard Blocksworld constraints: the arm holds at most one block,
  ;; only clear blocks can be picked up or unstacked, and stacking is only allowed
  ;; on a clear block.
  ;; BEGIN ADD
  (:predicates
    (on ?b ?c)
    (on-table ?b)
    (clear ?b)
    (holding ?b)
    (arm-empty))
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b))
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  ;; END ADD
)

    (on ?x ?y)

    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)

    :parameters (?b)

    :precondition (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (not (on-table ?b)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty))))
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: put down only a held block; it becomes clear on the table
    :precondition (holding ?b)
    :effect (and (on-table ?b) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b))))
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: stack only a held block on a clear destination
    :precondition (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c))
    :effect (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty) (not (holding ?b)) (not (clear ?c))))
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c)
    ;; CONSTRAINT: unstack only a clear block from another block with an empty arm
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and (holding ?b) (clear ?c) (not (on ?b ?c)) (not (clear ?b)) (not (arm-empty)))))
